purpose: [OPTIMIZED] Finds artifacts matching a symbol name and returns their details.
parameters:
Works on canonical LIVE artifact facts.
Returns defining module, kind, consumer count, and consumer module list.
Supply ``symbol_name`` or alias ``symbol``. Exact matches are preferred
over partial matches. ``limit`` bounds the response while ``total_matches``
and ``truncated`` describe omitted data. Consumers within every match are
bounded independently by ``evidence_limit``, always expose ``total`` and
``truncated``, and include ``items`` only when ``compact=False``. Pass
``None`` for all matches or all consumers. ``fields`` projects top-level keys
after compact shaping. Allowed values are ``query``, ``match_count``,
``total_matches``, ``truncated``, ``data_source``, and ``artifacts``.
usage_notes: LLM use: narrow ambiguous names before increasing ``limit``.
examples:
Searches by partial, case-insensitive match against the symbol part of
the artifact's full name (the part after '::', e.g. 'generate_graph'
matches 'generate_graph_analytics_report').
